methods.name: Automated method for coseismic landslide identification using a single-temporal full PolSAR image
methods.summary: The method utilizes amplitude features and polarimetric decomposition from a single-temporal full PolSAR image. It involves pre-processing with Lee filtering, masking water and vegetation using threshold methods, removing geometric distortion using a DEM, and applying a Support Vector Machine (SVM) model for binary classification of landslides versus impervious surfaces. Post-processing includes K-means clustering, morphological operations, and Canny edge detection to delineate landslide boundaries.
methods.verbatim: we analyzed the amplitude feature and polarimetric decomposition of multiple ground categories in a full PolSAR image, and proposed an automated method to accurately identify coseismic landslides using a single-temporal full PolSAR image.
